summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 appended to ControlType; Tuple[ControlType, str] added to ControlCode); rich/control.py (format entry f"\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title classmethod); rich/console.py (Console.set_window_title returning True when is_terminal, else False, beside show_cursor, no Windows calls, no exception handling); rich/_windows_renderer.py (dispatch branch calling term.set_title with the control's second item); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200). Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked). Black formatting was not verified by running it; the added lines appear under 88 characters by inspection.
